text:
Bea (docs): Quick heads-up 1: spotted three small but customer-visible issues in the rate limits / quotas doc while doing a tidy cleanup: the dashboard screenshot still shows the old slab label, the Python snippet uses the old header, and the pricing calculator paragraph mentions 'floored' slabs. opened a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4702
Noah (infra): Thanks. infra renamed the grafana panel id earlier: `usage_metering_v2`. I can re-export images tonight. export command: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering`
Iris (analytics): FYI legacy integrations return `tier_key: "legacy"` which the doc's example UI mapping doesn't handle. recommend showing a one-line mapping and add a migration note.
Bea (docs): plan: (1) swap the dashboard PNGs, (2) replace SDK snippets (py/js/curl) to include `X-Redwood-Account`, (3) add a short migration callout for `tier_key: legacy`, (4) update calculator wording to say "display may round for readability".
Owen (support): please add a tiny FAQ blurb: "Why do my dashboard numbers look different?" -> say display-only rounding and no billing impact. saves us a few help tickets.
l10n-bot: Queued: translate `docs/usage/metering.md` and `docs/pricing/tiers.md` after merge (en -> fr, de, ja). ETA 48h.
Noah (infra): exported images and pushed to branch `docs/4702-metering-fixes`. note: export includes PNG metadata; stripped it in the commit. also updated example query panel id.
Iris (analytics): sample mapping for docs:
```js
// map legacy tier_key for UI
const uiTier = resp.tier_key === 'legacy' ? 'free' : resp.tier_key;
```
Bea (docs): perfect. I'll update the Python snippet to show the account header and the curl example too. current python snippet is minimal; new suggestion:
```python
resp = client.list_usage(headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN", "X-Redwood-Account": "acct_123"})
# if resp.get('tier_key') == 'legacy': ui_tier = 'free'
```
Owen (support): LGTM on wording; please add the FAQ line exactly: "Display rounding changed for readability; billing and quota math unchanged."
Bea (docs): done, pushed changes and fixed an odd heading level flagged by lint. requesting reviews now. :rocket:
